key_finding: NO waveform-specific VQA dataset exists on HuggingFace. No oscilloscope screenshots, no SPICE waveform QA, no signal chart understanding datasets were found.

closest_analogs.description: Chart question answering with chart images and QA pairs. Cannot load directly with load_dataset (manual zip download needed).
closest_analogs.waveform_suitability: LOW - contains data visualization charts (bar/line/pie), not electronic waveforms. Could be used for transfer learning to teach general chart understanding.
closest_analogs.migration_plan: Could generate waveform images with matplotlib/ngspice, create QA pairs in ChartQA format. But requires building from scratch.

closest_analogs.description: VQA dataset with 28.9M QA pairs over 224K plots from real-world sources.
closest_analogs.waveform_suitability: LOW - contains data plots, not electronic waveforms. Same transfer learning potential as ChartQA.
closest_analogs.migration_plan: Same as ChartQA - would need to synthesize waveform plots.

closest_analogs.waveform_suitability: LOW - contains general figures, not waveforms.

eda_related.description: Multi-modal dataset for AI-driven circuit design. Supports timing/power prediction, RTL/netlist/layout. NOT waveform visualization.
eda_related.waveform_suitability: NONE - focuses on circuit design artifacts (RTL/netlist/layout), not waveform analysis or visualization.

signal_processing_datasets: mstz/waveform_noise_v1 (52 dl) - noise waveforms, not VQA
lucky9-cyou/MIMIC-IV-Waveform (132 dl) - medical waveforms, not VQA
rokaijano/extracel_waveforms (11303 dl) - extracellular waveforms, not VQA
subatomic-telemetry-lab/tpc-raw-waveform-dumps (495 dl) - raw waveform dumps, not VQA
conclusion: No ready-made waveform VQA dataset exists. The current approach of synthesizing waveforms with ngspice and creating tool-interaction QA pairs is the correct approach. ChartQA/PlotQA could be used for pre-training on general chart understanding, but electronic waveform understanding requires domain-specific data synthesis.
recommendation: Continue with ngspice-based waveform synthesis. Consider: (1) generating waveform images with matplotlib for multimodal VQA, (2) using ChartQA for pre-training chart understanding, (3) creating a waveform VQA benchmark from ngspice simulations for future work.
